programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Big Brother
programmes.d: Today's case involves a Samoan so Dog knows that the runner's close-knit kinfolk hold the keys to bringing him in. Dog's plan is to convince family that everyone is best served if the fugitive mans up and takes care of business.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Mid-Course Correction
programmes.d: Dog's target for today was once an upstanding member of his community. Now with no home, no job and the law on his trail, this middle-aged exile from middle-class society is using the cold end of an ice pipe to soothe his troubled soul.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Baby's Back in Town
programmes.d: Dog tries to nab a fugitive, named Wayne, by calling and telling him that he's won a new vacuum cleaner and he should stick around to get it. Dog then sends his daughter, Lyssa, to "deliver" the vacuum cleaner and lure Wayne out of his house.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Surprise! Surprise!
programmes.d: Dog and his team are out to revoke bail on Eugene, a chronic heroin addict. They find him in a squalid apartment with a huge stockpile of syringes, and they can see that his physical condition is deteriorating.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: No Ice in Paradise
programmes.d: Dog and his team fight the war on ice-crystal methamphetamine-on many fronts. They appear on a special anti-drug float in a parade. Then they go after bail-jumping Pana, a convicted drug dealer.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Fathers in Law
programmes.d: Hunting down a fugitive known as "Bozo," Dog gets help from an unexpected source, Bozo's father-in-law.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Bosco the Clown
programmes.d: Dog and the team get a big surprise after they track down Bosco, a fugitive who they believe is addicted to methamphetamines. They discover he's off drugs, settling into a normal life with a new girlfriend, and is very friendly.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Brother's Keeper
programmes.d: Leland has a full plate of fugitives in Kona, and the whole family heads to the Big Island to help.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Mama's Boys
programmes.d: Dog visits his mother's grave for inspiration before heading out to find Frankie, a violent fugitive hiding in the jungle. The spirit of Ma Chapman seems to help when Dog finds an unusual ally; Frankie's mother.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Lost in Paradise
programmes.d: Dog lectures high school students about the dangers of drugs before going after Joseph, a dangerous fugitive who won't be easy to capture.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Coaching Day
programmes.d: Dog takes the day off to try his hand at coaching, and assigns Tim and Leland to track down a dangerous fugitive on their own. Can the boys prove they can handle it?

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: The Women of Waikiki
programmes.d: The boys get distracted by the bikini-clad lovelies on Waikiki when they hunt for Lucy, a homeless, alcoholic fugitive. Beth is amused by the boys, but this is serious business: Tim will have to pay the bond if Lucy isn't caught.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: To Capture One's Own
programmes.d: Dog faces a tough personal and professional situation when he must hunt down his friend, Ili, who has helped him on many busts. But now Ili's on the other side of the law, and now Dog must bring her in.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Big Bags and Boxers
programmes.d: Dog is out to make two grabs on two islands in one day. Part of the team is goes to Kona to nab a woman who skipped her court date. Meanwhile, Dog and the others hunt Patrick, a fugitive who's fighting in an Extreme Boxing event on the Big Island.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Cats & Dogs
programmes.d: Dog has only a few days to catch a woman nicknamed Cats or forfeit Beth's $10,000 bond. But it won't be easy - Cats is eight months pregnant, so Dog will have to lure her in rather than risk a violent grab.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Destiny Love
programmes.d: Dog is in for a big surprise after he catches a fugitive named Jonaven in a sting operation.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: If You Knew Nunu
programmes.d: Dog and the team really have their hands full when they go after a tough guy named Nunu, who leads them on a chase through apartment complexes and a shopping mall before he's finally captured.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Double Trouble
programmes.d: Dog's feeling lucky, so he's going to try to capture two women in one day. The first, Moani, has "crazy" tattooed on her neck and is facing drug charges. The second fugitive, Jade, who turns out to be a tough catch, despite help from Jade's sister.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Big Island, Small Town
programmes.d: Dog has problems when he goes to a small town on the Big Island of Hawaii to track down a fugitive. In a small town, everyone knows everyone else's business, making it impossible for Dog to hunt in secret.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Jonah is Missing
programmes.d: Dog and the team search for Jonah, a violent and desperate criminal facing?20 years in jail. The trail goes stale when Dog runs into evasive family members and an angry girlfriend.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Suga On My Cuffs
programmes.d: Dog and the team go after Kandice, AKA Candy, AKA Suga, a stripper who didn't make her court appearance. They convince one of her friends to lure her to a supermarket parking lot, where Dog has an easy time fetching the fetching young thing. But then

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Mothers and Daughters
programmes.d: Dog and Beth take on the heartbreaking case of Rachel. Rachel's mom bailed her out of jail on condition that she go to AA meetings and stick to a curfew. But Rachel hasn't kept up her end of the bargain, and now her mother wants her back to jail.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Dog Is Smokin'
programmes.d: Dog is trying to cut down on smoking, but it's not easy with his high-stress job. Today, he must track down Walter, a fugitive who believes that the Canadian military has planted a chip in his tooth that allows him to communicate with his van.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: You Snooze, You Lose
programmes.d: Beth designs a luxurious new office for the team and shows it off to Dog, but the bounty hunter is more interested in starting his hunt for Federico, who's been revoked for missing court dates and generally running amuck.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Judgment Day
programmes.d: Dog goes on his a case, which involves Bobby, who's been on parole for three months pending sentencing on an assault charge. Bobby's girlfriend wants him back in jail, and Dog agrees that the Bobby needs to be behind bars.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Moms & Dads
programmes.d: Dog pursues two people whose lives have been ruined by drugs. First, he tracks Mae, who traded a good home and loving family for an ice pipe. The next case involves Jude. His addiction has caused his pregnant wife to fear for her safety.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Do Unto Others
programmes.d: Dog is a rough, tough bounty hunter, but he's a softie at heart, as the two cases in this episode show.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: A Helping Hand
programmes.d: Dog answers two very different calls for help from women. In the first case, he helps Leland protect Maria, who's being threatened by her violent husband. Then Dog visit a young woman who's dying and has asked to see Dog as one of her final wishes.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Take Your Daughter to Work Day
programmes.d: Baby Lyssa, who's just turned 18 and is studying to become a bondsman, gets to do some on-the-job training when she helps Dog hunt for Wayne, who's run out on a bond for second-degree assault.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: In Sickness and In Health
programmes.d: Dog is sick as a dog, but he still must lead the hunt for a fugitive named James. James' girlfriend tries to cover for him, but Dog surprises James in his bedroom and leads him away in cuffs.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: If the Shirt Fits...
programmes.d: Beth buys Dog a shirt with an embroidered chicken, but Dog explains he only wears shirts with pictures of either Jesus or a Harley-Davidson. When it's time to go to work, the team goes after Necia, a fugitive with felony charges pending.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: The Thief Who Stole Christmas
programmes.d: It's Christmas day, and Dog sets out to nab Raymond, who robs to support his ice habit, and give him a little Christmas gift - shiny new handcuffs.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Rock-a-Bye Bounty
programmes.d: Dog and Beth must go after their former housekeeper, Lisa, who's jumped bond. They know this case will be tricky because Lisa knows everyone in the family. Luckily, Beth's nephew, Jason, is visiting and is quickly put to work as the bait.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Father-Hood
programmes.d: Before Tim heads out for a tough day of bounty hunting, he likes to get in a little quality time with his daughter, Summer Rain.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Cops and Criminals
programmes.d: After giving a rousing speech to an audience of enthusiastic grade-schoolers, Dog catches up with an old friend, Sheriff Tommy Cayetano, to talk business. Dog's got a tough fugitive, named Mia, to catch and Tommy is happy to lend a hand.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Cupid in Cuffs
programmes.d: It's the day before Valentine's Day and love is in the air at Da Kine Bail Bonds--but not for Tapi who has failed to appear in court on theft charges. Dog's plan is to have Leland knock on Tapi's door with a Valentine's gift to draw her out.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Bonds of Love
programmes.d: Dog and Beth are finally getting married! They've been together for more than ten years but Dog is determined, as he puts it, to "marry his common law wife the Christian way."

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: To Love and to Cherish
programmes.d: Dog and Beth are off to the Big Island for their wedding. They hope to relax for a few days but it turns out Leland has a fugitive he needs to catch and despite the time limit, neither Dog nor Beth can resist the opportunity to catch a fugitive.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Bustin' with Justin
programmes.d: Dog and the team must deal with misleading informants, belligerent boaters, and angry drunks when they go after Kimberly, a traffic offender with over 20 violations. And if that isn't enough, Dog has another problem - Duane Lee is sick.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Run Fugitive, Run
programmes.d: When the team hunts for Steven, a fugitive with a history of domestic abuse, they seek help from his girlfriend, who's been a victim of his abuse. Meanwhile, Beth trains for a 5K race to help raise awareness about domestic abuse.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Vegas or Bust
programmes.d: Dog is going to be the keynote speaker at the annual Profession Bail Agents convention in Las Vegas, but before he leaves he's got to clear two cases from his docket - Heidi and Stephanie.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Playing Possum
programmes.d: Tim's got a big problem. Owen has failed to appear in court. He's on bond for serious drug charges and now Tim could lose $30,000 if he doesn't catch Owen. With Dog's help he tries to track down the co-signer but they come up dry.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Rainy Day Woman
programmes.d: It's been raining for days and the team is going a little stir crazy, but Dog has the cure; a good hunt. Maui has failed to appear on a drug charge and the team has just one lead. She was recently spotted during a bust at a local chop shop garage.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Ticket to Ride
programmes.d: Dog decides it's time to outfit the Da Kine crew with new SUVs. After a quick visit to their local dealership, they go after Jasmine, a woman whose criminal record includes over 37 arrests for everything from drug promotion to assault.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Mother Knows Best
programmes.d: Dog has two fugitives to catch, and he gets help from the unlikeliest sources - the fugitives' mothers. First, Ginger's mother wants to revoke her daughter's bond. Then, Brandon's mother decides to revoke his bond because Brandon has an ice habit.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Irons in the Fire
programmes.d: Dog is back hunting in the big city of Denver, but chasing fugitives on the mainland is more dangerous than ever. So Dog decides that the crew should get pepper-ball guns, which have much better range than pepper spray.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Rocky Mountain Roundup
programmes.d: Dog decides to help two of his bondsmen buddies, Dave "Red" Widhelm and "Downtown" Bobby Brown. First up is Red, who has a client, named Alvin, whose bond is $20,000. Then the team goes after Craig, a client of Bobby's whose bond is almost $70,000.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: This One's For You
programmes.d: Dog leads the team on another adrenaline-filled chase in Denver. The fugitive, Robert, has a habit of address-hopping that makes him a difficult target, but Dog refuses to give up and finally tracks Robert down in his latest hideaway.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Baby Lyssa Steps Up
programmes.d: The team is still in Colorado, and today Dog starts his day by to giving his kids and crew a sample of their western heritage by taking them horseback riding. This hunt takes Dog back to his old stomping grounds in Denver.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Running on Empty
programmes.d: Dog's time is running out in Colorado. After a month of helping his bail bondsmen friends around Denver, he's got to get his family back home to Hawaii. But Dog wants one more capture before they leave.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Inside Out
programmes.d: Dog kickstarts the search for Jackson, a 240lbs, six feet tall bad boy who has skipped out on a $10,000 bond. Jackson’s apparently at his father-in-law's house, but the father-in-law has info about Jackson that brings Dog to a unique hideout.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Growing Up Is Hard To Do
programmes.d: With twelve kids of his own, Dog knows how hard it is to keep children on the straight and narrow, especially during their turbulent teens.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Year of the Dog
programmes.d: A one-hour special that looks back at 2006, one of Dog's most tumultuous years, which has included the passing of Beth's father, Dog and Beth's wedding, the tragic death of Dog's daughter Barbara.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: The Mystery of Mona Lisa
programmes.d: When Lyssa points out that the fugitive in the next case has the same birth date as Barbara, Dog's recently deceased daughter, the team takes a special vow to capture the young woman.
